Our philosophy

Good research does not end with a thick report. It ends when the decision becomes clear.

Questions before data

A sharp research question saves time and budget. We agree on the core question before collecting a single data point.

Evidence before opinion

Every finding traces back to a source, a dataset, or a pattern you can check. Assumptions are labeled as assumptions.

Patterns before trends

We compare across contexts to find what lasts, not just what is loud today.

Decisions before documents

Deliverables are built to be used: an executive summary, practical implications, and clear next steps.

About

A research lab built for decisions.

F4ntzy Research Lab is the research and development arm of the F4ntzy brand. We help brands, companies, founders, and researchers turn vague questions into well-structured, defensible studies that are ready to use.

Our foundation is a documented research habit. Every session and topic is logged, so the depth of our work can be seen rather than merely claimed. We pair that discipline with structural modeling, statistical analysis, and qualitative brand audits.

One result of this approach is a peer-reviewed journal publication on purchase behavior in competitive games, which now shapes how we build studies: a clear theoretical framework, clean data, and practical recommendations.

Selected publication

If Aesthetics Don't Drive Gamer Enjoyment, What Does? Insight from Valorant Skin Purchases. Trisnawijaya, M. S., & Ardyan, E. Ilomata International Journal of Management, Vol. 7, No. 3 (2026), 971 to 979. DOI: 10.61194/ijjm.v7i3.2189
